targets.expr: topk(5, rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_block_read_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"}[15m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id

targets.expr: topk(10, rate( cnpg_pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"} [5m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id
topk(10, rate( cnpg_pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"} [5m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id
